A_static.score: mean over the 3 benign refs of the frozen COMPOSITE pair distance at a checkpoint scope: intermediate scope = weighted(assertions .40, actions .25); final scope = weighted(assertions .40, decisions .25, outcomes .10); weights are the frozen experimental DEFAULT_WEIGHTS, component mask = benign-pair intersection
A_static.construct_differs_from_m1_union: YES: M1 = logical OR of 4 independent dimension indicators vs per-dim benign-calibrated theta; checkpoint = single weighted scalar with fixed experimental weights.  An outcome-only change (weight .10) must exceed the composite threshold 8x more than an assertion change to fire; a uniform 0.5 across all 4 dims fires the composite at 0.5 either way — the construct is not the 4-dim union.
A_static.null_comparable: the checkpoint null pools BENIGN-pair composite distances (inter list for the inter gate, final list for the final gate), LOO-excluding the cell, q98 family pool — matched in cardinality AND construct to the perturbed composite.  It is comparable at CHECKPOINT scope; it is NOT the whole-trace p3 null (different object).
A_static.multiple_opportunities: the gate is an OR over (intermediate peak, final): each row can be flagged through several checkpoint observations; the probe-observation FPR under-reports the row-level FPR.  See C below.

C_row_level_fpr.note: row-or FPR = the B2B control's ROW-level false positive rate (any benign probe in the cell's pools firing); the reported checkpoint B2B FPR in cache_v6_cells.json is the probe-observation rate (1057/115404 = 0.92%).  Row-level is the relevant denominator for per-execution FPR; the gap is the multiple-opportunity effect.

B_per_dimension_diagnostic.note: per-component benign pools are SAMPLE-SCALE (150 cells: 60 M2-cal-positive + 90 negative, seeded agentprop-audit-cases-20270125 family... see script), not full-frame: a feasibility + direction diagnostic, clearly labeled as such.  Full-frame implementation is feasible from these artifacts (no new inference required) — see the feasibility statement.

gate_comparison_sample_scale.interpretation: Sample: 150 requested (60 M2-cal-positive of 732; 90 M2-cal-negative of 16041; seed 20270125), 143 extractable (7 trace-load/ref gaps). Composite calibrated gate fired on 60/143 = ALL extractable M2-cal-pos rows and 0/90 M2-cal-neg rows (by construction, on the negative half the gate is the definition of the label, so 0 negatives is expected and informative only about per-dim divergence below).  Per-dimension gate fired on 58/143: overlap 45 (75% of the 60 positives); composite-only 15 rows (the weighted scalar exceeds pooled q98 while NO single component exceeds its own q98 — the composite can fire from several moderate component moves that no individual dim certifies); per-dim-only 13 rows (a component exceeds its own q98 while the weighted composite does not — the under-represented low-weight components, outcomes weight 0.10 and final-scope decisions 0.25, must move 8x/4x as far as assertions 0.40 to move the scalar). CONCLUSION: the checkpoint gate is a genuinely DIFFERENT construct from the 4-dim union design; it is NOT the intended methodology (no weighted composite is permitted in the scored pipeline, spec §0.2.1).  Agreement 45/60 = 75% shows the composite is a coarse approximation that systematically under-weights outcome-level deviation.  Directional, sample-scale only (n=143, M2-positive-enriched) — NOT a full-frame measurement; a full-frame dimension-specific checkpoint null is feasible (see feasibility) but NOT implemented here to respect the no-re-tuning standing rule.
gate_comparison_sample_scale.per_dimension_fires_note: per-dimension fire counts are summed over dimensions; a cell can fire on several dims.  final_decisions (30) and final_assertions (27) dominate: the final-scope composite under-weights them (0.25 and 0.40 of the weighted sum, but the q98 per-dim threshold is set independently per component, so a decision-only deviation fires the per-dim gate at a much lower raw level than the composite).

B_per_dimension_diagnostic.feasibility: DIMENSION-SPECIFIC CHECKPOINT CALIBRATION IS FEASIBLE from existing artifacts: _pair_computation exposes the per-component distance values (comps dict) at the SAME strict-basis checkpoint construction the composite uses; no new LLM calls, trace generation, or extraction are required — only a re-scoring pass over the frozen checkpoint machinery.  The composite M1 union design (4 independent dims, logical OR, no weights) is therefore implementable at checkpoint level; the current checkpoint gate is NOT that design.
